purpose: Professional CS2 opening responsibility benchmark and independent replication
primary_metric: Unique conditional identity NLL, equal weight to series then trained seeds

foundation.freeze: All pretrained parameters except final ICL block, final normalization and decoder
foundation.upstream: Bundled TabICLv2 public pretrained checkpoint; no claim of equal upstream pretraining

occurrence: Same seed-averaged validation-selected CatBoost occurrence head within each full, ablation or training-size condition; choice metrics remain conditional
ablation_scope: All inputs to both heads are transformed and heads retrained; no absolute position does not mean removal of every geometric or regional signal
training_size_subset: Nested whole-series order from SHA256(CS2-training-amount-v1:series_id), fixed before outcomes
primary_selection: Lowest mean development identity NLL among all ten full methods before external data is opened
external_rule: All configurations, weights and preprocessing locked before opening the separate external NPZ. Test-based replacement or tuning is unavailable.
